authority: User-accepted grouping list transport and warning clarifications, 2026-10-01; focused refinement of the pinned transport leaves, not a changed design pin.

cursor.filter_fingerprint: canonical SHA256 over query_id,version,sort_registry_id,null_order,state,risk,origin; every filter and ordering/version change rejects continuation
cursor.raw_keys: after_created_at_utc and after_proposal_id remain internal only; public query rejects them

GroupingProposalPageV1.exact_total: complete filtered result count, independent of page length

fields.origin: same closed owner origin vocabulary as query
fields.state: same closed owner lifecycle vocabulary as query

fields.task_change_count: same owner affected Task exact count
fields.objective_change_count: same owner affected Objective exact count

owner_warnings.GROUPING_PROPOSAL_STALE: Exact shared GroupingProposalDetail stale semantics: complete expected Task/plan/membership/Objective/envelope material and reproduction as the same current grouping candidate. No list-only weaker predicate.
owner_warnings.GROUPING_EQUIVALENT_REJECTION: An unreconsidered regroup_rejection_events row exists for exact input_fingerprint, equivalent to RegroupProposalRepository.rejection_suppressed.

classification_rules: Same stable read snapshot as page and exact count. Batch supporting authority reads; never call proposal_detail per item.
No warning inferred from high risk, origin, lifecycle, generic lock/overlap/competing state.
Empty owner_warnings only after both predicates affirmatively false. Uncertain/integrity/resource classification fails closed.

implementation_bounds.all_state_seek_headers: at most four*(limit+1), using existing state/created/id index
implementation_bounds.classification_capture: snapshot-local and bounded by the existing 100000 synchronous grouping threshold; oversized supporting material or manual page candidate work returns GROUPING_INDETERMINATE, never an authoritative clear/stale guess

mutation_contract.GroupingProposalV1: Unchanged compact mutation/core DTO for accept/reject/reconsider; not expanded with list presentation.
mutation_contract.GroupingRecomputeResultV1.proposals: GroupingRecomputeProposalPageV1; immutable commit-time projection, distinct from the live list page.

fields.state: same closed owner lifecycle vocabulary as query
fields.origin: same closed owner origin vocabulary as query

rules: No owner_warnings, stale, equivalent-rejection suppression or current read-time classifications in command results.
Durable recompute retains empty immediate page exact_total=0 and job_id.
Exact replay returns original stored immutable result without reclassification or transformation; historical results are not rewritten.
LLD10 refreshes the live owner list separately; command results are not refreshed list rows.

route_error_refinement.reason: Accepted classification must fail closed when exact supporting authority cannot be established; reuse the existing owner error code.
